test_case.test_name: One-shot fatal XGMI link-1 DataLossErr with OAM/AID CPER and fabric recovery proof
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved fatal XGMI data-loss event on the enumerated physical link 1 and prove OOB/surviving in-band CPER identify mapped OAM/AID, XGMI, ext0 DataLossErr and fatal severity, followed by complete fabric recovery.
required_package: Signed live block-7 enumeration and physical link-1/OAM/AID map
Compatible amdgpuras/firmware/Redfish/cdump ext0 schema and fatal-event contract
Dedicated non-production SUT, one-shot authorization, durable logs and rehearsed console/power/fabric recovery
Authenticated paginated CPER access and secure storage
Post-recovery full XGMI topology/link width/speed/GPU health oracle
test_case.test_command: FATAL RAS GATE CLOSED. Preserve complete persistent CPER/fabric/system baselines, run read-only b7 enumeration and obtain signed link-1/OAM/AID binding. After recovery rehearsal and point approval execute exactly once `sudo amdgpuras -b 7 -m 0 -t 4 -s 1`. Capture fatal/link/console timeline, recover only through the signed path, enumerate/hash/decode all causal CPER and validate full fabric topology. No correctable/link substitution, clear, max-ID/plaintext shortcut or retry.
test_case.expected_result: One approved action produces the signed fatal/link-loss and recovery sequence; causal evidence reports mapped OAM/AID, XGMI, ext0 DataLossErr and fatal severity, and every intended XGMI link/GPU returns healthy with approved width/speed/state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed live link-1/OAM/AID identity, one b7/m0/t4/s1 action, causal ext0 DataLossErr fatal evidence and complete recovered fabric/GPU topology. FAIL on wrong link/AID, missing or extra fatal event, persistent link loss, width/speed degradation, GPU loss, recovery breach or evidence gap. Unsigned prerequisites are NOT READY.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until live topology, isolated SUT, durable evidence and fabric recovery are signed/rehearsed.
One fatal action only with explicit point approval; expect in-band loss.
No clear, correctable/link substitution or retry.
Quarantine on incomplete fabric restoration or uncertain GPU state.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, full b7 enumeration and signed link-1/OAM/AID map
Version/fatal/recovery contract, persistent baselines and authorization
Paginated CPER raw/hash/decode and available in-band reconciliation
test_case.recovery: On unexpected fatal/link behavior, control loss, wrong DataLoss event or recovery deadline breach, stop and preserve evidence. Do not inject, clear or automatically power-cycle. Use only rehearsed vendor fabric recovery, quarantine incomplete topology and require owner release.
